Immutable SpotLike state variable spot = 0x65C79fcB50Ca1594B025960e539eD7A9a6D434A3; Maker Spotter contract that is poked with collateral type identifiers (e.g. "ETH-A").
internal process(): iterates over all OSM state variables, calls pass() and, if true, poke(), then calls spot.poke(bytes32) for each collateral type. No access control, no return value.
external poke(): calls process(), then if univ2daiusdt.pass() calls univ2daiusdt.poke(), then spot.poke("UNIV2DAIUSDT-A"). Permissionless entry point.
external pokeTemp(): calls process() only; comment states it is used for poking OSMs prior to collateral being added. Permissionless entry point.
External state-changing call OsmLike.poke() executed on every OSM state variable when pass() returns true; cross-contract call that can re-enter the caller.
External view call OsmLike.pass() executed on every OSM state variable to decide whether poke() is required; result used as a branch condition.
External state-changing call spot.poke(bytes32) issued for ~30 collateral type identifiers (ETH-A, BAT-A, ..., UNIV2AAVEETH-A, UNIV2DAIUSDT-A); updates the Maker Spotter price feeds.
msg.sender: implicit caller of the unrestricted external functions poke() and pokeTemp(); any account can trigger the full OSM and Spot price update sequence.
